reason: false positive, NVD lists httpcomponents_core 5.0 through 5.4.2 plus the 5.5 pre-releases alpha1 and beta1 as affected; the CPE entries for 5.5:alpha1 and 5.5:beta1 are matched against the 5.5 GA release, which is not affected. Pinned to 5.5; registered: 2026-11-23

reason: accepted until the Spring Boot 4 migration; Spring Framework 6.2.19 is the last 6.2 release. Affected features are server-side WebFlux, RSocket, the Jetty reactive adapter, Aalto XML, WebFlux WebSocket and functional endpoints. spring-webflux is only a transitive jar of spring-ai-openai and WebClient is unused; there is no reactive server runtime (no reactor-netty, Jetty, Aalto or RSocket on the classpath) and OryxOS runs as a Spring MVC servlet application on Tomcat or with web-application-type none; registered: 2026-11-23

reason: accepted until the Spring Boot 4 migration; Spring Framework 6.2.19 is the last 6.2 release. Affected features are unused: SSE and SSE view fragments, XsltView rendering (no XSLT view resolver; the only view is the explicit forward:/admin/index.html), SpEL evaluation of user input (no SpEL parser in OryxOS code), data binding of user-supplied property paths (JSON request bodies only, no @ModelAttribute or DataBinder); registered: 2026-11-23

reason: accepted until the Spring AI 2 migration; Spring AI 1.1.8 is the last 1.1 release. OryxOS uses only the low-level OpenAiApi and @Tool schema generation: no PDF document reader (CVE-2026-47851), no ONNX transformers module (CVE-2026-47852), and Spring AI tool dispatch is not used; ToolPolicy rejects tools outside the Agent allowlist before any IO (CVE-2026-59318, covered by ToolSafetyContractTest); registered: 2026-11-23
